result.finding: Estimated final image size ~250-350MB: eclipse-temurin:8-jre base (~220MB) plus the Spring Boot fat JAR (~80-120MB). Multi-stage build keeps build tools out of the final image.
evidence: Final stage base image: eclipse-temurin:8-jre (~220MB typical for JRE-only Temurin image)
No additional apt-get/apk/yum package installations in Dockerfile
Multi-stage build: Maven and JDK only in build stage, not copied to final image
Spring Boot fat JAR expected ~80-120MB (includes embedded Tomcat and all dependencies)
ENTRYPOINT copies only app.jar to final image
